name: CreateLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the CLB instance.

You can call the [](t2293290.xdita#)operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401682.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the CLB instance. Valid values:

internet: After an Internet-facing CLB instance is created, the system allocates a public IP address to the instance. The CLB instance can forward requests over the Internet.

intranet: After an internal-facing CLB instance is created, the system allocates a private IP address to the CLB instance. The CLB instance can forward requests only within the VPC
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的网络类型。取值：

internet：创建公网负载均衡实例后，系统会分配一个公网IP地址，可以转发公网请求。
intranet：创建专有网络类型的负载均衡实例后，系统会分配一个内网IP地址，仅可转发内网请求
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en:
The Internet data transfer metering method for the Internet-facing CLB instance. Valid values:

paybytraffic (default): pay-by-data-transfer

paybybandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth

If you set PayType to PayOnDemand and InstanceChargeType to PayByCLCU, the only valid value for InternetChargeType is paybytraffic.

If you set InternetChargeType to paybytraffic, you do not need to configure the Bandwidth parameter. The value of Bandwidth does not take effect even if you specify one
parameters.help_zh:
公网类型实例的付费方式。取值：

paybytraffic（默认值）：按使用流量计费。
paybybandwidth：按固定带宽计费。


当PayType取值PayOnDemand且InstanceChargeType取值PayByCLCU时，该参数仅支持取值paybytraffic。
如果选择了paybytraffic，无需设置Bandwidth的值；如您设置了Bandwidth值，该值也不会生效
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth of the instance. Unit: Mbit/s.

Valid values: 1 to 5000.

Only when AddressType is set to internet and InternetChargeType is set to paybybandwidth, this parameter takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
实例的带宽峰值，单位：Mbps。
    
取值范围：1～5000。

仅 AddressType取值为internet，且InternetChargeType取值为paybybandwidth时，该参数生效
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The CLB instance name.

The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically assigns a name to the CLB instance
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的名称。

长度为1～80个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

不指定该参数时，默认由系统分配一个实例名称
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the CLB instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的所属的VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the CLB instance belongs.

If you want to deploy the CLB instance in a VPC, this parameter is required. If this parameter is specified, AddessType is set to intranet by default.

The vSwitch must be in the primary zone
parameters.help_zh:
专有网络实例的所属的交换机ID。

创建专有网络类型的负载均衡实例，必须指定该参数。如果指定了该参数，AddressType参数的值会默认被设置为intranet。

请确保该VSwitchId所在可用区与主可用区一致
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the primary zone to which the CLB instance belongs.

You can call the [](t2293253.xdita#)operation to query the primary and secondary zones in the region where you want to create the CLB instance.

The primary zone must be the zone where the vSwitch resides
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的主可用区ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27585.html接口可查到相应地域下的主备可用区信息。

请确保该主可用区与VSwitchId所在可用区一致
parameters.name: master_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the secondary zone to which the CLB instance belongs.

You can call the [](t2293253.xdita#)operation to query the primary and secondary zones in the region where you want to create the CLB instance
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的备可用区ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27585.html接口查询相应地域下的主备可用区信息
parameters.name: slave_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the CLB instance. Valid values:

slb.s1.small

slb.s2.small

slb.s2.medium

slb.s3.small

slb.s3.medium

slb.s3.large

If InstanceChargeType is set to PayByCLCU, this parameter is invalid and you do not need to specify this parameter.

As of 00:00:00 (UTC+8) on June 1, 2025, pay-by-specification CLB instances are no longer available for purchase. For more details, see [](t2857909.xdita#)
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的规格。取值：

slb.s1.small
slb.s2.small
slb.s2.medium
slb.s3.small
slb.s3.medium
slb.s3.large

<props="china">

当InstanceChargeType取值为PayByCLCU，该参数不生效，您无需配置该参数。
若不指定规格，则创建性能共享型实例。目前，共享型实例已停止售卖，请指定实例规格。

</props>

<props="intl">

当InstanceChargeType取值为PayByCLCU，该参数不生效，您无需配置该参数。
CLB按规格计费实例已于2025年06月01日00:00:00（北京时间，UTC+8）停止售卖。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2872003.html。


</props>
parameters.name: load_balancer_spec

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the CLB instance. Valid value:

PayOnDemand: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的计费类型，取值：

PayOnDemand：按量付费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the subscription Internet-facing CLB instance. Valid values:

month

year

This parameter is supported only by subscription instances created on the Alibaba Cloud China site
parameters.help_zh:
预付费公网实例的计费周期，取值：
month：月。
year：年。

该参数仅适用于中国站且仅对包年包月实例有效
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the Internet-facing CLB instance. Valid values:

If PricingCycle is set to month, the valid values are 1 to 9.

If PricingCycle is set to year, the valid values are 1 to 5.

This parameter is supported only by subscription instances created on the Alibaba Cloud China site
parameters.help_zh:
预付费公网实例的购买时长，取值：
  
如果PricingCycle为month，取值为1～9。
如果PricingCycle为year，取值为1～5。

该参数仅适用于中国站且仅对包年包月实例有效
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically pay the subscription fee of the Internet-facing CLB instance. Valid values:

true: yes. The CLB instance is created after you call the API operation.

false (default): After you call the operation, the order is created but the payment is not completed. You can view pending orders in the console. The CLB instance will not be created until you complete the payment.

This parameter takes effect only for subscription CLB instances created on the Alibaba Cloud China site
parameters.help_zh:
是否是自动支付预付费公网实例的账单。取值：

true：自动支付。调用API后，立即生成SLB实例。
false（默认值）：调用API后SLB的订单创建成功，但是未支付。您可以在控制台看到未支付订单。由于订单未支付，SLB实例不会被创建出来。

该参数仅适用于中国站且仅对包年包月实例有效
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The IP version of the CLB instance. Valid values: ipv4 and ipv6
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的IP版本，取值：ipv4或ipv6
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the CLB instance. The private IP address must belong to the destination CIDR block of the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 指定实例的私网IP地址，该地址必须包含在交换机的目标网段下
parameters.name: address

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the bastion host. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be at most 64 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It must not start with `aliyun` or `acs:`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。
最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the CLB instance. Valid values:

on

off
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启实例删除保护。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: delete_protection

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the configuration read-only mode. Valid values:

NonProtection: disables the configuration read-only mode. After you disable the configuration read-only mode, the value of ModificationProtectionReason is cleared.

ConsoleProtection: enables the configuration read-only mode.

If you set this parameter to ConsoleProtection, you cannot modify instance configurations in the CLB console. However, you can modify instance configurations by calling API operations
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡修改保护状态：

NonProtection：不限制修改保护，设置后会清空之前设置的ModificationProtectionReason。
ConsoleProtection：实例控制台修改保护状态。

当取值为ConsoleProtection，即开启修改保护后，用户不能通过负载均衡控制台修改实例配置，但可以通过调用API修改实例配置
parameters.name: modification_protection_status

parameters.help_en:
The reason for enabling the configuration read-only mode. The reason must be 1 to 80 characters in length. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

This parameter takes effect only when ModificationProtectionStatus is set to ConsoleProtection
parameters.help_zh:
设置修改保护状态的原因，长度为1～80个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，支持数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

仅在ModificationProtectionStatus为ConsoleProtection时有效
parameters.name: modification_protection_reason

parameters.help_en:
The resource metering method for the CLB instance. Valid value:

PayByCLCU: pay-by-data-transfer

As of 00:00:00 (UTC+8) on June 1, 2025, pay-by-specification CLB instances are no longer available for purchase. For more details, see [](t2857909.xdita#)
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">

实例计费方式。取值：
PayBySpec（默认值）：按规格计费。
PayByCLCU：按使用量计费。

仅当PayType（实例付费模式）取值为PayOnDemand（按量付费）时，该参数生效。

</props>

<props="intl">

实例计费方式。

取值：PayByCLCU：按使用量计费。

仅当PayType（实例付费模式）取值为PayOnDemand（按量付费）时，该参数生效。
CLB按规格计费实例已于2025年06月01日00:00:00（北京时间，UTC+8）停止售卖。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2872003.html。


</props>
